subject: How do I configure my website?
body: Please explain how to configure the main settings for my website.

subject: Website page is not loading
body: My website page keeps showing an error and I cannot access it. How can I troubleshoot this?

subject: Request for a new website
body: We need a website for our business with five pages and a contact form. Please explain the next steps.

subject: Request for cancellation and refund
body: I would like to cancel my subscription and know whether I am eligible for a refund.

subject: Unhappy with the support received
body: I contacted support several times but my problem has not been resolved. I am disappointed with the service.

subject: Request for project quotation
body: Could you provide a quotation for building a business website? Please explain the pricing options.

subject: Following up on my previous request
body: I am following up on my earlier email. Could you please let me know if there is an update?
conversation_context: The customer previously asked for an update on a support request.

subject: Urgent: website is unavailable
body: Our business website is unavailable and customers cannot access it. Please help us resolve this urgently.

subject: Can you confirm your refund policy?
body: Before I decide whether to cancel, please explain the applicable refund policy and any conditions.

subject: Need help with an existing configuration
body: I followed the configuration instructions but one of the settings is not behaving as expected. Could you guide me?
conversation_context: The customer has already attempted the documented configuration steps.
